checks.name: eligibility_containment
checks.description: No INELIGIBLE / REVIEW_REQUIRED / dismissed job carries a score (the Stage-3 SCORE-gate contract).

checks.name: eligible_coverage
checks.description: Every ELIGIBLE job has a score of some kind (hybrid or AI).

checks.name: hybrid_coverage
checks.description: Every ELIGIBLE job has a hybrid (free) score. Before 2026-10-07 this was 0 across the board because the free pass was fed the AI query.

checks.name: no_fabricated_zeros
checks.description: No AI score of exactly 0 — the D1 artifact class, where a job the model never returned was padded with a fabricated zero.

checks.name: role_match_cap
checks.description: No AI score above the cap while role_match is explicitly false (D3b).
